findings.one_line: The expected Bernoulli Fisher information is E[{P_a(1-P_a)}^{-1}], not (E[P_a(1-P_a)])^{-1} as used in (26); consequently the displayed Van-Trees denominator and its asserted exact lower bound do not follow. Replace kappa by the former quantity and redo the uniform expansion (the discrepancy appears repairably smaller than the claimed second-order scale).

cited_checks.note: The attested Appendix C gives Ai''=xAi, positivity/nonpositivity beyond a_1', and the two asymptotics, which yield the stated ratio; simplicity follows at a_1' from Ai''(a_1')=a_1'Ai(a_1') nonzero.
The attested Theorem 2.1 states invariance reduction to X distributed as p+Bin(r,1/2) with estimand (p-q)/n.
The attested Theorems 2.1--2.2 give the reduced minimax identity, unique posterior-mean minimax rule with least-favorable prior, and equality to the joint design-and-estimator value.
The attested Theorem 2.3 states the exact (U-L)^2 value multiplier and conditional-Bernoulliization construction.
